description: Feedlot Waste Data is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. The cattle feedlot data has been collated from a phone survey conducted by the Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development (DPIRD) in October 2017. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Its tags are WA-LC. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
